const std = @import("std");
const Tensor = @import("../core/tensor.zig").Tensor;

pub const OFTB = struct {
    pub const FRACTAL_SCALE: f32 = 0.7071067811865476;

    dim: usize,

    pub fn init(d: usize) OFTB {
        std.debug.assert(d != 0);
        std.debug.assert(d <= std.math.maxInt(usize) / 2);
        return OFTB{
            .dim = d,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *OFTB) void {
        self.* = undefined;
    }

    pub fn forwardInPlace(self: OFTB, x: *Tensor) !void {
        if (self.dim == 0) return error.InvalidDimension;
        if (self.dim > std.math.maxInt(usize) / 2) return error.DimensionOverflow;
        const total = self.dim * 2;
        if (x.data.len != total) return error.DimensionMismatch;
        const half = self.dim;
        const x1 = x.data[0..half];
        const x2 = x.data[half..][0..half];
        const scale: f32 = FRACTAL_SCALE;
        const VLEN: usize = 8;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i + VLEN <= half) : (i += VLEN) {
            const va: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = x1[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vb: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = x2[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vscale: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = @splat(scale);
            x1[i..][0..VLEN].* = (va - vb) * vscale;
            x2[i..][0..VLEN].* = (va + vb) * vscale;
        }
        while (i < half) : (i += 1) {
            const a = x1[i];
            const b = x2[i];
            x1[i] = (a - b) * scale;
            x2[i] = (a + b) * scale;
        }
    }

    pub fn backwardInPlace(self: OFTB, grad: []f32) !void {
        if (self.dim == 0) return error.InvalidDimension;
        if (self.dim > std.math.maxInt(usize) / 2) return error.DimensionOverflow;
        const total = self.dim * 2;
        if (grad.len != total) return error.DimensionMismatch;
        const half = self.dim;
        const g1 = grad[0..half];
        const g2 = grad[half..][0..half];
        const scale: f32 = FRACTAL_SCALE;
        const VLEN: usize = 8;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i + VLEN <= half) : (i += VLEN) {
            const va: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = g1[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vb: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = g2[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vscale: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = @splat(scale);
            g1[i..][0..VLEN].* = (va + vb) * vscale;
            g2[i..][0..VLEN].* = (vb - va) * vscale;
        }
        while (i < half) : (i += 1) {
            const a = g1[i];
            const b = g2[i];
            g1[i] = (a + b) * scale;
            g2[i] = (b - a) * scale;
        }
    }
};

pub fn mixForward(oftb: OFTB, x: *Tensor) !void {
    try oftb.forwardInPlace(x);
}

pub fn mixBackward(oftb: OFTB, grad: []f32) !void {
    try oftb.backwardInPlace(grad);
}

test "OFTB forward then backward returns input within 1e-5 tolerance" {
    const allocator = std.testing.allocator;
    var prng = std.Random.DefaultPrng.init(42);
    const random = prng.random();

    const dim: usize = 32;
    const total = dim * 2;

    var input = try Tensor.init(allocator, &.{ 1, total });
    defer input.deinit();
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < input.data.len) : (i += 1) {
        input.data[i] = (random.float(f32) - 0.5) * 2.0;
    }

    const original = try allocator.dupe(f32, input.data);
    defer allocator.free(original);

    var oftb = OFTB.init(dim);
    try oftb.forwardInPlace(&input);
    try oftb.backwardInPlace(input.data);

    i = 0;
    while (i < input.data.len) : (i += 1) {
        try std.testing.expectApproxEqAbs(input.data[i], original[i], 1e-5);
    }

def FRACTAL_SCALE : ℝ := Real.sqrt 2 / 2

structure Tensor where
  data : Array ℝ

inductive OFTBError where
  | InvalidDimension : OFTBError
  | DimensionOverflow : OFTBError
  | DimensionMismatch : OFTBError

structure OFTB where
  dim : Nat

def forwardScalar (a b : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b), FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))

def backwardScalar (a b : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b), FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))

def forwardInPlaceCore (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) : Array ℝ :=
  if i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))).symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))).symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        forwardInPlaceCore half data2 (i + 1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
  else data
termination_by half - i

def backwardInPlaceCore (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) : Array ℝ :=
  if i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))).symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))).symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))
        backwardInPlaceCore half data2 (i + 1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
  else data
termination_by half - i

def OFTB.forwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor) : Except OFTBError Tensor :=
  match Nat.decEq self.dim 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.InvalidDimension
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
    match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) self.dim with
    | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionOverflow
    | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq x.data.size (self.dim * 2) with
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
        Except.ok ⟨forwardInPlaceCore self.dim x.data 0⟩

def OFTB.backwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (grad : Array ℝ) : Except OFTBError (Array ℝ) :=
  match Nat.decEq self.dim 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.InvalidDimension
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
    match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) self.dim with
    | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionOverflow
    | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq grad.size (self.dim * 2) with
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
        Except.ok (backwardInPlaceCore self.dim grad 0)

def forwardArray (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) : (Fin half → ℝ) × (Fin half → ℝ) :=
  (fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (x1 i - x2 i), fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (x1 i + x2 i))

def backwardArray (half : Nat) (g1 g2 : Fin half → ℝ) : (Fin half → ℝ) × (Fin half → ℝ) :=
  (fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (g1 i + g2 i), fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (g2 i - g1 i))

def roundtripArray (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) : (Fin half → ℝ) × (Fin half → ℝ) :=
  let p := forwardArray half x1 x2
  backwardArray half p.1 p.2

theorem two_nonneg_real : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 :=
  le_of_lt two_pos

theorem sqrt2_mul_self : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 :=
  Real.mul_self_sqrt two_nonneg_real

theorem FRACTAL_SCALE_sq : FRACTAL_SCALE * FRACTAL_SCALE = 1 / 2 :=
  Eq.trans
    (div_mul_div_comm (Real.sqrt 2) 2 (Real.sqrt 2) 2)
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· / (2 * 2)) sqrt2_mul_self)
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (div_div 2 2 2))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (· / 2) (div_self two_ne_zero))
          (one_div 2))))

theorem helper_add_pair' (a b : ℝ) : (a - b) + (a + b) = 2 * a :=
  Eq.trans
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· + (a + b)) (sub_eq_add_neg a b))
      (Eq.trans
        (add_assoc a (-b) (a + b))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (a + ·) (Eq.symm (add_assoc (-b) a b)))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (a + ·) (congrArg (· + b) (add_comm (-b) a)))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (a + ·) (add_assoc a (-b) b))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (a + ·) (congrArg (a + ·) (neg_add_cancel b)))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (a + ·) (add_zero a))
                  (Eq.symm (two_mul a)).symm.symm)))))))
    (two_mul a).symm.symm

theorem helper_sub_pair' (a b : ℝ) : (a + b) - (a - b) = 2 * b :=
  Eq.trans
    (sub_eq_add_neg (a + b) (a - b))
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg ((a + b) + ·) (congrArg Neg.neg (sub_eq_add_neg a b)))
      (Eq.trans
        (congrArg ((a + b) + ·) (neg_add a (-b)))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg ((a + b) + ·) (congrArg ((-a) + ·) (neg_neg b)))
          (Eq.trans
            (add_assoc a b ((-a) + b))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (a + ·) (Eq.symm (add_assoc b (-a) b)))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (a + ·) (congrArg (· + b) (add_comm b (-a))))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (a + ·) (add_assoc (-a) b b))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.symm (add_assoc a (-a) (b + b)))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (· + (b + b)) (add_neg_cancel a))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (zero_add (b + b))
                        (Eq.symm (two_mul b)))))))))))))

theorem scale_mul_scale_mul_two (x : ℝ) : FRACTAL_SCALE * FRACTAL_SCALE * (2 * x) = x :=
  Eq.trans
    (congrArg (· * (2 * x)) FRACTAL_SCALE_sq)
    (Eq.trans
      (mul_comm (1 / 2) (2 * x))
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (mul_assoc (2 * x) 1 2⁻¹) ▸
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (· * (1 / 2)) (mul_comm (1 / 2) (2 * x)))
            (Eq.trans
              (mul_assoc (2 * x) (1 / 2) 1)
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg ((2 * x) * (1 / 2) * ·) (mul_one 1))
                (mul_one ((2 * x) * (1 / 2)))))
        )
        (Eq.trans
          (Eq.symm (mul_assoc 2 x (1 / 2)))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (· * x) (mul_one_div 2 2 ▸ mul_comm 2 (1 / 2) ▸ mul_one_div_cancel two_ne_zero))
            (one_mul x)))))

theorem scale_mul_scale_mul_two' (x : ℝ) : FRACTAL_SCALE * (FRACTAL_SCALE * (2 * x)) = x :=
  Eq.trans
    (Eq.symm (mul_assoc FRACTAL_SCALE FRACTAL_SCALE (2 * x)))
    (scale_mul_scale_mul_two x)

theorem forward_backward_scalar (a b : ℝ) :
    backwardScalar (forwardScalar a b).1 (forwardScalar a b).2 = (a, b) :=
  let s := FRACTAL_SCALE
  let a' := s * (a - b)
  let b' := s * (a + b)
  have hsum : a' + b' = s * (2 * a) :=
    Eq.trans
      (Eq.symm (mul_add s (a - b) (a + b)))
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) (helper_add_pair' a b))
  have hdif : b' - a' = s * (2 * b) :=
    Eq.trans
      (Eq.symm (mul_sub s (a + b) (a - b)))
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) (helper_sub_pair' a b))
  have ha : s * (a' + b') = a :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) hsum)
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (mul_assoc s s (2 * a)))
        (scale_mul_scale_mul_two a))
  have hb : s * (b' - a') = b :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) hdif)
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (mul_assoc s s (2 * b)))
        (scale_mul_scale_mul_two b))
  Prod.ext ha hb

theorem forward_backward_point (a b : ℝ) :
    (let s := FRACTAL_SCALE
     let a' := (a - b) * s
     let b' := (a + b) * s
     ((a' + b') * s, (b' - a') * s)) = (a, b) :=
  let s := FRACTAL_SCALE
  have hc1 : (a - b) * s = s * (a - b) := mul_comm (a - b) s
  have hc2 : (a + b) * s = s * (a + b) := mul_comm (a + b) s
  have h := forward_backward_scalar a b
  have h1 : s * (s * (a - b) + s * (a + b)) = a := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h2 : s * (s * (a + b) - s * (a - b)) = b := congrArg Prod.snd h
  have k1 : ((a - b) * s + (a + b) * s) * s =
      s * (s * (a - b) + s * (a + b)) :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· * s) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hc1 hc2))
      (mul_comm (s * (a - b) + s * (a + b)) s)
  have k2 : ((a + b) * s - (a - b) * s) * s =
      s * (s * (a + b) - s * (a - b)) :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· * s) (congrArg₂ (· - ·) hc2 hc1))
      (mul_comm (s * (a + b) - s * (a - b)) s)
  Prod.ext
    (Eq.trans k1 h1)
    (Eq.trans k2 h2)

theorem forward_array_fst_apply (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) (i : Fin half) :
    (forwardArray half x1 x2).1 i = FRACTAL_SCALE * (x1 i - x2 i) := rfl

theorem forward_array_snd_apply (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) (i : Fin half) :
    (forwardArray half x1 x2).2 i = FRACTAL_SCALE * (x1 i + x2 i) := rfl

theorem backward_array_fst_apply (half : Nat) (g1 g2 : Fin half → ℝ) (i : Fin half) :
    (backwardArray half g1 g2).1 i = FRACTAL_SCALE * (g1 i + g2 i) := rfl

theorem backward_array_snd_apply (half : Nat) (g1 g2 : Fin half → ℝ) (i : Fin half) :
    (backwardArray half g1 g2).2 i = FRACTAL_SCALE * (g2 i - g1 i) := rfl

theorem roundtripArray_fst (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) :
    (roundtripArray half x1 x2).1 = x1 :=
  funext fun i =>
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·)
        (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
          (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·) rfl)
          (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·) rfl)))
      (congrArg Prod.fst (forward_backward_scalar (x1 i) (x2 i)))

theorem roundtripArray_snd (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) :
    (roundtripArray half x1 x2).2 = x2 :=
  funext fun i =>
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·)
        (congrArg₂ (· - ·)
          (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·) rfl)
          (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·) rfl)))
      (congrArg Prod.snd (forward_backward_scalar (x1 i) (x2 i)))

theorem roundtripArray_eq (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) :
    roundtripArray half x1 x2 = (x1, x2) :=
  Prod.ext
    (roundtripArray_fst half x1 x2)
    (roundtripArray_snd half x1 x2)

theorem half_lt_total (d i : Nat) (hi : i < d) : i < d * 2 :=
  Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right d Nat.zero_lt_two)

theorem half_add_lt_total (d i : Nat) (hi : i < d) : d + i < d * 2 :=
  Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi d) (Eq.symm (Nat.two_mul d))

theorem forward_preserves_length_core (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) :
    (forwardInPlaceCore half data i).size = data.size :=
  if h : i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))
        let hs1 : data1.size = data.size :=
          Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) hs1.symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) hs1.symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let hs2 : data2.size = data1.size :=
          Array.size_set data1 ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        Eq.trans
          (forward_preserves_length_core half data2 (i + 1))
          (Eq.trans hs2 hs1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
  else Eq.refl data.size
termination_by half - i

theorem backward_preserves_length_core (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) :
    (backwardInPlaceCore half data i).size = data.size :=
  if h : i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let hs1 : data1.size = data.size :=
          Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) hs1.symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) hs1.symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))
        let hs2 : data2.size = data1.size :=
          Array.size_set data1 ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))
        Eq.trans
          (backward_preserves_length_core half data2 (i + 1))
          (Eq.trans hs2 hs1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
  else Eq.refl data.size
termination_by half - i

theorem OFTB_forward_mismatch (d : Nat) (x : Tensor)
    (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hmax : ¬ Nat.max / 2 < d)
    (hlen : x.data.size ≠ d * 2) :
    OFTB.forwardInPlace ⟨d⟩ x = Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch :=
  Eq.mpr
    (congrArg (· = Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch)
      (show OFTB.forwardInPlace ⟨d⟩ x =
          (match Nat.decEq d 0 with
           | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hd
           | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
             match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) d with
             | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hmax
             | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
               match Nat.decEq x.data.size (d * 2) with
               | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
               | Decidable.isTrue heq => absurd heq hlen) from
        rfl))
    (match Nat.decEq d 0 with
     | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hd
     | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
       match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) d with
       | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hmax
       | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
         match Nat.decEq x.data.size (d * 2) with
         | Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl (Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch)
         | Decidable.isTrue heq => absurd heq hlen)

theorem OFTB_backward_mismatch (d : Nat) (grad : Array ℝ)
    (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hmax : ¬ Nat.max / 2 < d)
    (hlen : grad.size ≠ d * 2) :
    OFTB.backwardInPlace ⟨d⟩ grad = Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch :=
  Eq.mpr
    (congrArg (· = Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch)
      (show OFTB.backwardInPlace ⟨d⟩ grad =
          (match Nat.decEq d 0 with
           | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hd
           | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
             match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) d with
             | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hmax
             | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
               match Nat.decEq grad.size (d * 2) with
               | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
               | Decidable.isTrue heq => absurd heq hlen) from
        rfl))
    (match Nat.decEq d 0 with
     | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hd
     | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
       match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) d with
       | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hmax

pub const OFTB = struct {

        std.debug.assert(d <= std.math.maxInt(usize) / 2);

        };

        self.* = undefined;

        if (self.dim == 0) return error.InvalidDimension;
        if (self.dim > std.math.maxInt(usize) / 2) return error.DimensionOverflow;
        const total = self.dim * 2;
        if (x.data.len != total) return error.DimensionMismatch;
        const half = self.dim;
        const x1 = x.data[0..half];
        const x2 = x.data[half..][0..half];
        const scale: f32 = FRACTAL_SCALE;
        const VLEN: usize = 8;
        var i: usize = 0;

            const va: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = x1[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vb: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = x2[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vscale: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = @splat(scale);

            x2[i..][0..VLEN].* = (va + vb) * vscale;

        while (i < half) : (i += 1) {
            const a = x1[i];
            const b = x2[i];
            x1[i] = (a - b) * scale;
            x2[i] = (a + b) * scale;

            const va: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = g1[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vb: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = g2[i..][0..VLEN].*;
            const vscale: @Vector(VLEN, f32) = @splat(scale);

            const a = g1[i];

        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))).symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))).symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        forwardInPlaceCore half data2 (i + 1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
  else data
termination_by half - i

def backwardInPlaceCore (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) : Array ℝ :=
  if i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))).symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) (Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))).symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))
        backwardInPlaceCore half data2 (i + 1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => data
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => data
  else data
termination_by half - i

def OFTB.forwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor) : Except OFTBError Tensor :=
  match Nat.decEq self.dim 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.InvalidDimension
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
    match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) self.dim with
    | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionOverflow
    | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq x.data.size (self.dim * 2) with
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
        Except.ok ⟨forwardInPlaceCore self.dim x.data 0⟩

def OFTB.backwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (grad : Array ℝ) : Except OFTBError (Array ℝ) :=
  match Nat.decEq self.dim 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.InvalidDimension
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
    match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) self.dim with
    | Decidable.isTrue _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionOverflow
    | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq grad.size (self.dim * 2) with
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
        Except.ok (backwardInPlaceCore self.dim grad 0)

def forwardArray (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) : (Fin half → ℝ) × (Fin half → ℝ) :=
  (fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (x1 i - x2 i), fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (x1 i + x2 i))

def backwardArray (half : Nat) (g1 g2 : Fin half → ℝ) : (Fin half → ℝ) × (Fin half → ℝ) :=
  (fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (g1 i + g2 i), fun i => FRACTAL_SCALE * (g2 i - g1 i))

def roundtripArray (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) : (Fin half → ℝ) × (Fin half → ℝ) :=
  let p := forwardArray half x1 x2
  backwardArray half p.1 p.2

theorem two_nonneg_real : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 :=
  le_of_lt two_pos

theorem sqrt2_mul_self : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 :=
  Real.mul_self_sqrt two_nonneg_real

theorem FRACTAL_SCALE_sq : FRACTAL_SCALE * FRACTAL_SCALE = 1 / 2 :=
  Eq.trans
    (div_mul_div_comm (Real.sqrt 2) 2 (Real.sqrt 2) 2)
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· / (2 * 2)) sqrt2_mul_self)
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (div_div 2 2 2))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (· / 2) (div_self two_ne_zero))
          (one_div 2))))

theorem helper_add_pair' (a b : ℝ) : (a - b) + (a + b) = 2 * a :=
  Eq.trans
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· + (a + b)) (sub_eq_add_neg a b))
      (Eq.trans
        (add_assoc a (-b) (a + b))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (a + ·) (Eq.symm (add_assoc (-b) a b)))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (a + ·) (congrArg (· + b) (add_comm (-b) a)))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (a + ·) (add_assoc a (-b) b))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (a + ·) (congrArg (a + ·) (neg_add_cancel b)))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (a + ·) (add_zero a))
                  (Eq.symm (two_mul a)).symm.symm)))))))
    (two_mul a).symm.symm

theorem helper_sub_pair' (a b : ℝ) : (a + b) - (a - b) = 2 * b :=
  Eq.trans
    (sub_eq_add_neg (a + b) (a - b))
    (Eq.trans
      (congrArg ((a + b) + ·) (congrArg Neg.neg (sub_eq_add_neg a b)))
      (Eq.trans
        (congrArg ((a + b) + ·) (neg_add a (-b)))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg ((a + b) + ·) (congrArg ((-a) + ·) (neg_neg b)))
          (Eq.trans
            (add_assoc a b ((-a) + b))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (a + ·) (Eq.symm (add_assoc b (-a) b)))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (a + ·) (congrArg (· + b) (add_comm b (-a))))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (a + ·) (add_assoc (-a) b b))
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.symm (add_assoc a (-a) (b + b)))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (· + (b + b)) (add_neg_cancel a))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (zero_add (b + b))
                        (Eq.symm (two_mul b)))))))))))))

theorem scale_mul_scale_mul_two (x : ℝ) : FRACTAL_SCALE * FRACTAL_SCALE * (2 * x) = x :=
  Eq.trans
    (congrArg (· * (2 * x)) FRACTAL_SCALE_sq)
    (Eq.trans
      (mul_comm (1 / 2) (2 * x))
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (mul_assoc (2 * x) 1 2⁻¹) ▸
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (· * (1 / 2)) (mul_comm (1 / 2) (2 * x)))
            (Eq.trans
              (mul_assoc (2 * x) (1 / 2) 1)
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg ((2 * x) * (1 / 2) * ·) (mul_one 1))
                (mul_one ((2 * x) * (1 / 2)))))
        )
        (Eq.trans
          (Eq.symm (mul_assoc 2 x (1 / 2)))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (· * x) (mul_one_div 2 2 ▸ mul_comm 2 (1 / 2) ▸ mul_one_div_cancel two_ne_zero))
            (one_mul x)))))

theorem scale_mul_scale_mul_two' (x : ℝ) : FRACTAL_SCALE * (FRACTAL_SCALE * (2 * x)) = x :=
  Eq.trans
    (Eq.symm (mul_assoc FRACTAL_SCALE FRACTAL_SCALE (2 * x)))
    (scale_mul_scale_mul_two x)

theorem forward_backward_scalar (a b : ℝ) :
    backwardScalar (forwardScalar a b).1 (forwardScalar a b).2 = (a, b) :=
  let s := FRACTAL_SCALE
  let a' := s * (a - b)
  let b' := s * (a + b)
  have hsum : a' + b' = s * (2 * a) :=
    Eq.trans
      (Eq.symm (mul_add s (a - b) (a + b)))
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) (helper_add_pair' a b))
  have hdif : b' - a' = s * (2 * b) :=
    Eq.trans
      (Eq.symm (mul_sub s (a + b) (a - b)))
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) (helper_sub_pair' a b))
  have ha : s * (a' + b') = a :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) hsum)
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (mul_assoc s s (2 * a)))
        (scale_mul_scale_mul_two a))
  have hb : s * (b' - a') = b :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (HMul.hMul s) hdif)
      (Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (mul_assoc s s (2 * b)))
        (scale_mul_scale_mul_two b))
  Prod.ext ha hb

theorem forward_backward_point (a b : ℝ) :
    (let s := FRACTAL_SCALE
     let a' := (a - b) * s
     let b' := (a + b) * s
     ((a' + b') * s, (b' - a') * s)) = (a, b) :=
  let s := FRACTAL_SCALE
  have hc1 : (a - b) * s = s * (a - b) := mul_comm (a - b) s
  have hc2 : (a + b) * s = s * (a + b) := mul_comm (a + b) s
  have h := forward_backward_scalar a b
  have h1 : s * (s * (a - b) + s * (a + b)) = a := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h2 : s * (s * (a + b) - s * (a - b)) = b := congrArg Prod.snd h
  have k1 : ((a - b) * s + (a + b) * s) * s =
      s * (s * (a - b) + s * (a + b)) :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· * s) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hc1 hc2))
      (mul_comm (s * (a - b) + s * (a + b)) s)
  have k2 : ((a + b) * s - (a - b) * s) * s =
      s * (s * (a + b) - s * (a - b)) :=
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· * s) (congrArg₂ (· - ·) hc2 hc1))
      (mul_comm (s * (a + b) - s * (a - b)) s)
  Prod.ext
    (Eq.trans k1 h1)
    (Eq.trans k2 h2)

theorem roundtripArray_fst (half : Nat) (x1 x2 : Fin half → ℝ) :
    (roundtripArray half x1 x2).1 = x1 :=
  funext fun i =>
    Eq.trans
      (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·)
        (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
          (congrArg (FRACTAL_SCALE * ·) rfl)

theorem forward_preserves_length_core (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) :
    (forwardInPlaceCore half data i).size = data.size :=
  if h : i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))
        let hs1 : data1.size = data.size :=
          Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a - b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) hs1.symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) hs1.symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let hs2 : data2.size = data1.size :=
          Array.size_set data1 ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        Eq.trans
          (forward_preserves_length_core half data2 (i + 1))
          (Eq.trans hs2 hs1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
  else Eq.refl data.size
termination_by half - i

theorem backward_preserves_length_core (half : Nat) (data : Array ℝ) (i : Nat) :
    (backwardInPlaceCore half data i).size = data.size :=
  if h : i < half then
    match Nat.decLt i data.size, Nat.decLt (half + i) data.size with
    | Decidable.isTrue h1, Decidable.isTrue h2 =>
        let a := data.get ⟨i, h1⟩
        let b := data.get ⟨half + i, h2⟩
        let data1 := data.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let hs1 : data1.size = data.size :=
          Array.size_set data ⟨i, h1⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (a + b))
        let h1' : i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (i < ·) hs1.symm) h1
        let h2' : half + i < data1.size :=
          Eq.mpr (congrArg (half + i < ·) hs1.symm) h2
        let data2 := data1.set ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))
        let hs2 : data2.size = data1.size :=
          Array.size_set data1 ⟨half + i, h2'⟩ (FRACTAL_SCALE * (b - a))
        Eq.trans
          (backward_preserves_length_core half data2 (i + 1))
          (Eq.trans hs2 hs1)
    | Decidable.isTrue _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl data.size
    | Decidable.isFalse _, Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl data.size
  else Eq.refl data.size
termination_by half - i

theorem OFTB_forward_mismatch (d : Nat) (x : Tensor)
    (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hmax : ¬ Nat.max / 2 < d)
    (hlen : x.data.size ≠ d * 2) :
    OFTB.forwardInPlace ⟨d⟩ x = Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch :=
  Eq.mpr
    (congrArg (· = Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch)
      (show OFTB.forwardInPlace ⟨d⟩ x =
          (match Nat.decEq d 0 with
           | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hd
           | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
             match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) d with
             | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hmax
             | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
               match Nat.decEq x.data.size (d * 2) with
               | Decidable.isFalse _ => Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch
               | Decidable.isTrue heq => absurd heq hlen) from
        rfl))
    (match Nat.decEq d 0 with
     | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hd
     | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
       match Nat.decLt (Nat.max / 2) d with
       | Decidable.isTrue h => absurd h hmax
       | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
         match Nat.decEq x.data.size (d * 2) with
         | Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl (Except.error OFTBError.DimensionMismatch)
         | Decidable.isTrue heq => absurd heq hlen)

        (Eq.mpr (congrArg (· < eps) abs_zero) heps))

A `sq_sum_diff` tétel törött: szerepel benne ez a rész:

```lean
(Eq.symm (add_assoc b ^ 2 (2 * a ^ 2) (() )))
```

## A Zig és Lean eltérése

A Zig `f32` aritmetikát használ, míg a Lean modell `ℝ`-et. Ez alapvető szemantikai eltérés. A Zig konstans ténylegesen egyszeres pontosságú lebegőpontos értékké kerekítődik, a Leanben viszont `Real.sqrt 2 / 2` egzakt valós szám.

Ezért a Lean-tétel azt mondja ki, hogy egy **ideális valós számok feletti ortogonális transzformáció** inverze pontosan visszaadja a bemenetet. A Zig teszt ezzel szemben lebegőpontos végrehajtást tesztel, ezért csak `1e-5` abszolút toleranciát vár el. Az IEEE-754 lebegőpontos viselkedés külön formalizálandó szemantikai terület.[2]

A Leanben használt

```lean
def FRACTAL_SCALE : ℝ := Real.sqrt 2 / 2
```

nem reprezentálja ezt a Zig értéket:

```zig
pub const FRACTAL_SCALE: f32 = 0.7071067811865476;
```

A két érték matematikailag közeli, de nem azonos típusú és nem azonos futási szemantikájú. Emiatt még egy hibátlan valós számok feletti Lean-bizonyítás sem verifikálja a Zig `f32` implementációt.
